paragraphs: R' Yishmael ben Luga, in R' Akiva's time, [Yoma 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.38a.14). [Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 3, on “Who is this,”](https://www.sefaria.org/Shir_HaShirim_Rabbah.3.6.4) reads Shimon ben Luga.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Yoma has Rabbi Akiva report an account he heard from Rabbi Yishmael ben Luga.

The linked Midrash gives Shimon ben Logah (לוגה) in the parallel account, and the linked [Yerushalmi Shekalim](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shekalim.5.1.21) also has Logah (לוגה), rendered Lagos in its English translation. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3433&lang=en) records those parallels and proposes correcting the name Yishmael in the Bavli.
